source_title: One Piece: 6 Characters That Can Beat Elbaf Luffy, Ranked
source_excerpt:
The protagonist of One Piece, Monkey D. Luffy, has come incredibly far ever since he set out on his journey to become the Pirate King. Luffy has achieved tremendous abilities over the years, and right now he stands among the Four Emperors of the Sea. At the same time, Luffy is also the Sun God Nika of the One Piece world, the powers of which he received from his Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika Awakening.
As a god of the world, Luffy is easily one of the strongest. However, there are still characters that operate above this level of strength. The Elbaf arc has made it quite clear that there are many characters in the One Piece world who are stronger than Luffy right now and that he will have to surpass them as he moves forward on his quest to obtain the One Piece.
The Accursed Prince of Elbaf, Loki, is one of the most powerful characters in the world of One Piece, and right now, he is most certainly stronger than Luffy. He holds the power of the legendary Devil Fruit of Elbaf, named the Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhoggr. This Devil Fruit allows him to transform into the largest Dragon in existence, with the ability to spit lightning at his disposal.
Loki also has the power of the Ice Squirrel, Ratatoskr, whose abilities have been infused in his hammer, Ragnir. Loki is the second coming of the God of War of Elbaf, and based on everything that we have seen in the Elbaf arc, he is most certainly stronger than Luffy right now. While Luffy could go on to surpass him by the end of the arc, right now, Loki is most certainly stronger and can't defeat him in combat, especially because his stamina is far better. Loki is also stated to hold enough power to destroy the entire world, and his destructive capabilities, stemming from his lightning-based abilities, are immaculate. Luffy, although incredibly strong, doesn't have anything in his arsenal that can match what Loki can put out with his Devil Fruit.
Shamrock Figarland is one of the most powerful characters to exist in the world of One Piece. He is the elder twin of Shanks and one of the members of the Holy Knights. While both Sommers and Killingham proved to be rather weak, Shamrock is an incredibly powerful figure who is implied to be even stronger than Loki.
Shamrock has the Depths Covenant with Nerona Imu, granting him access to the powers of immortality, regeneration, and superhuman strength. On top of that, he is also a very skilled blade wielder and has access to the power of Cerberus, the guardian of hell. Shamrock also has powerful Haki. On top of all this, and when taken into consideration along with everything else, he is certainly above Luffy right now and can defeat him in combat.
Luffy's very own father, Monkey D. Dragon, is certainly stronger than him as things stand. Dragon is the leader and Supreme Commander of the Revolutionary Army, and a very powerful Devil Fruit user. It is unclear what Devil Fruit ability he wields, but his ability has already been teased by Oda on various occasions.
On top of that, Dragon is also a very skilled user of Haki of all three types . His mastery over the Color of the Supreme King has not been revealed yet, but given that he is one of the biggest threats to Nerona Imu right now, it goes without saying that Dragon is incredibly powerful. It is no surprise to know that he exists as one of the leading forces in the world who has built an army strong enough to rival and dispose of the World Government. Taking that into consideration, Dragon should be stronger than Luffy right now.
Blackbeard is one of the Four Emperors of the Sea, and he attained this title after obtaining two Devil Fruits and then making his presence known in the New World. Blackbeard currently stands as one of the biggest threats in the One Piece world. He has a bounty of 3.996 billion berries, and his overall powers are absolutely immense.
Blackbeard is known to wield two legendary Devil Fruits called Yami Yami no Mi and Gura Gura no Mi. With the first one, he can cancel out all other Devil Fruit abilities, and the second holds the power to destroy the entire world. On top of that, Blackbeard has access to Haki as well. While he has not been explicitly confirmed to be a user of the Color of the Supreme King, it goes without saying that he has access to this power as well.
When taken into consideration with everything he has at his disposal, Blackbeard is easily one of the strongest in the world. He is also the inheritor of the Will of D., which means that he stands as a rival to Imu currently . Blackbeard's overall power is nothing short of immense, and by the end of One Piece, he will most certainly become one of the most powerful characters on the seas. Right now, Blackbeard is most definitely stronger than Luffy, and a big reason for that is his ability to cancel all abilities, including Luffy's Gear 5.
Shanks is one of the Four Emperors of the Seas and also among the strongest characters that are currently alive in the world of One Piece. He has a bounty of 4.0489 billion berries, and even though he doesn't have access to a Devil Fruit, he is still incredibly powerful.
Shanks primarily relies on his Haki in battle, and he seems to have advanced all his Haki types to the next level. Among them, Shanks has especially mastered the Color of the Supreme King, which makes him one of the deadliest fighters sailing the seas. Shanks's Conqueror's Haki is so strong that it was directly compared to that of Joy Boy in the Egghead arc.
As things stand, he is significantly stronger than Monkey D. Luffy, and there is absolutely no doubt about that. It must be remembered that Shanks is Luffy's ultimate goal, and the protagonist will only go on to surpass him, and the two meet in combat at some point later down the line.
The King of the World, Nerona Imu, stands as the strongest character in the entirety of One Piece right now. Imu is the user of the powerful Akuma no Mi. He also has the ability to utilize all three powerful types of Haki at a very high level. In fact, his Haki was stated by both Scopper Gaban and Loki to be preposterous and far greater than anything they had ever seen. On top of that, Imu can also manipulate the counterpart of Haki, known as Maki. This ability makes Imu one of the most deadly and versatile characters in the entirety of One Piece.
In the Elbaf arc, Luffy and Imu fought in a very high-intensity battle, but this battle ended within two chapters and almost led to the death of Monkey D. Luffy. Had it not been for Scopper Gaban, Luffy would already have died in this battle to a severely nerfed Imu who can't even output his maximum power. When taking into consideration the fact that Imu is currently nerfed, it is easy to see that he is significantly stronger than Elbaf Luffy and that this will continue to be the case for quite some time.
One Piece can be read on Manga Plus.
Mayumi Tanaka Monkey D. Luffy (voice)
One Piece is a Japanese manga written and illustrated by Eiichiro Oda. The series follows protagonist Monkey D. Luffy and his Straw Hat Pirate crew as they explore the Grand Line to find the King of the Pirates' ultimate treasure, the One Piece, in order to become the next king. The manga's popularity helped it spin off into a larger media franchise, including an anime with more than 1,000 episodes.
